paused_by.description: Who ordered this pause. Only the owner (anh) can: a blocked step with this field is a pause he ordered, legal with no open ask and never listed as waiting on him. paused_by, pause_quote and pause_msg come together and only on a blocked step; leaving blocked clears them.

pause_msg.description: The feedback id of the OWNER message that ordered the pause. The board checks that it exists, was written by the owner on this task and holds pause_quote verbatim in words he typed himself (not an ask text copied into his answer); the quote must order a pause: at least 10 characters, 3 words and a pause word; pause_at is taken from that message, never from the writer.

pause_quote.description: The owner's own words ordering the pause, verbatim.

pause_at.description: When the owner ordered the pause: the time of the owner message pause_msg, set by the board.

phase.description: The task phase this step belongs to (a phase id of the task). With the phase rules on (BOARD_PHASE_RULES_SINCE) a new step on a task with phases must name one.

state_at.description: When the step was created or its state last changed (server clock). Absent on steps written before the stamp existed.

lane.description: The lane that owns this record. Absent means the task's lane. s21: a step or ask of another lane on a shared task.
